scripts._comment_smoke: Plan 2 smoke test — see docs/superpowers/smoke-tests/2026-05-08-plan-2-workspace-sharing.md. Postgres dev container is on port 5433 (host has another Postgres on 5432). LAN scripts hardcode 192.168.30.164 — edit if your Tailscale/LAN IP changes. The repo .env is owned by root and points at port 5432; we override DATABASE_URL inline so we don't have to touch it.
scripts.smoke:api: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://fina:fina@localhost:5433/fina WEB_APP_URL=http://localhost:3100 BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://localhost:4000 APPLE_ENV=sandbox CRON_ENABLED=false nx run api:dev
scripts.smoke:api:lan: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://fina:fina@localhost:5433/fina WEB_APP_URL=http://192.168.30.164:3100 BETTER_AUTH_URL=http://192.168.30.164:4000 DEV_ORIGINS=http://192.168.30.164:3100 APPLE_ENV=sandbox CRON_ENABLED=false nx run api:dev
scripts.smoke:mobile:lan: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://192.168.30.164:4000 EXPO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL=http://192.168.30.164:3100 EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID=287347024529-d8t4lqc5s0tlin407ees3juug913gkqv.apps.googleusercontent.com EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID=287347024529-9kscoil7sm759d1kl459t7554o95vdlb.apps.googleusercontent.com FINA_IOS_ALLOW_LOCAL_NETWORKING=1 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME=192.168.30.164 pnpm --filter @fina/mobile exec expo start --host lan --clear
scripts.smoke:db:reset: docker exec fina-postgres-dev psql -U fina -d fina -c 'TRUNCATE TABLE invites, memberships, workspaces, verifications, sessions, accounts, users RESTART IDENTITY CASCADE;'
scripts.release:android: cd apps/mobile && pnpm exec eas build --platform android --profile production --auto-submit --non-interactive
scripts.release:android:aab: cd apps/mobile && pnpm exec eas build --platform android --profile production --non-interactive
scripts.submit:android: cd apps/mobile && pnpm exec eas submit --platform android --profile production --latest --non-interactive
